gherkin.scenario: Pay a bill from an account
given: I am logged in as a user
when: I click the Bill Pay link
I fill in the Payee Name field with 'test'
I fill in the Address field with 'test'
I fill in the City field with 'test'
I fill in the State field with 'test'
I fill in the Zip Code field with '12345'
I fill in the Phone field with '1234567890'
I fill in the Account field with '12345'
I fill in the Verify Account field with '12345'
I fill in the Amount field with '100'
I select account '12345' from the From Account dropdown
I click the Send Payment button
then: The page should display 'Bill Payment Complete'
